platform.summary: Infineon PSoC 6 · ModusToolbox 3.x · FreeRTOS 10.4 · Wi-Fi · MQTT/TLS
platform.notes: Synthetic fixture used by the test suite

summary.overview: Synthetic review used to exercise the renderer in CI. The numbers and findings are made up.
key_risks: A credential is committed in source
A linked library has a published vulnerability
strengths: Watchdog is enabled and kicked from the main loop

findings.title: MQTT password committed in source
findings.description: The broker password and an API key are compiled into every unit as string literals.
findings.impact: Anyone with a firmware image, or any one device, can read the shared credential and impersonate every device in the fleet.
findings.recommendation: Provision a per-device credential at manufacture, store it in protected flash and rotate the leaked one now.

findings.title: zlib 1.2.11 has published vulnerabilities (CVE-2018-25032, CVE-2022-37434)
findings.description: OSV.dev lists two advisories against the linked zlib tag. Whether the affected inflate paths are compiled in and reachable from external input has not been confirmed.
findings.impact: If reachable from network input, a crafted stream can corrupt heap memory.
findings.recommendation: Update to zlib 1.3.x, or confirm the affected functions are not linked.

findings.title: Magic numbers for retry limits
findings.description: Retry counts are literals scattered across the file.
findings.recommendation: Name the constants in one header.
